summary: 4-Sprint Improvements Plan: P0 Deployment Documentation, P0 GDPR Performance Optimization, P1 CI/CD Pipeline, and P1 Browser-CLI Comprehensive Testing. Sprints 01 and 02 are parallel-capable but will execute sequentially due to single-agent constraint.

phases.name: Sprint 01 - Deployment Documentation (P0)
phases.description: Create comprehensive deployment documentation to eliminate tribal knowledge dependency. Critical gap blocking production deployments.

subtasks.description: Read and analyze existing deployment references in package.json scripts and environment configurations
acceptanceCriteria: All VITE_, CONVEX_, WORKOS_ env vars cataloged

subtasks.description: CREATE docs/DEPLOYMENT.md with Prerequisites, Environment Configuration, Deployment Steps (Backend + Frontend), WorkOS Configuration, Rollback Procedures, and Health Check documentation
acceptanceCriteria: All environment variables documented with examples
Staging deployment: npm run convex:deploy documented
Production deployment: npm run convex:deploy:prod documented

subtasks.description: MODIFY README.md: Add deployment section referencing docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, remove any Semble references
acceptanceCriteria: README.md has Deployment section linking to docs/DEPLOYMENT.md

phases.gateCondition: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md exists and contains all required sections, README.md updated

phases.name: Sprint 02 - GDPR Stats Performance (P0)
phases.description: Optimize getGDPRStats query which performs full table scans. Implement server-side caching via scheduled job to achieve <2s load time.

subtasks.description: MODIFY convex/schema.ts: Add gdprStatsCache table with fields pendingErasures, activePatients, activeConsents, recentAuditCount, computedAt
acceptanceCriteria: Fields: pendingErasures (number), activePatients (number), activeConsents (number), recentAuditCount (number), computedAt (number)

subtasks.description: CREATE convex/scheduled/gdprStatsCache.ts: Internal mutation computeStats that aggregates counts from erasureRequests, patients, consents tables and writes to cache
acceptanceCriteria: Uses withIndex for efficient counting where available

subtasks.description: MODIFY convex/crons.ts: Register 5-minute interval cron job calling gdprStatsCache.computeStats
acceptanceCriteria: Cron job registered: refresh gdpr stats

subtasks.description: REPLACE convex/gdprModules/stats.ts: getGDPRStats query reads from cache first (if <5min old), falls back to limited live computation with take(100)
acceptanceCriteria: No full table scans in production query path

subtasks.description: Deploy and verify: Run convex dev, trigger scheduled job, verify GDPR dashboard loads in <2 seconds
acceptanceCriteria: npx convex dev starts without errors
Scheduled job can be triggered manually
npx convex logs shows computeStats execution
GDPR dashboard query time <500ms in logs

phases.gateCondition: GDPR stats caching implemented, scheduled job registered, getGDPRStats reads from cache

phases.name: Sprint 03 - CI/CD Pipeline (P1)
phases.description: Implement GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline for test enforcement on PRs and automated deployments. Depends on Sprint 01 deployment docs.

subtasks.description: CREATE .github/workflows/ci.yml: Jobs for typecheck, lint, test, e2e with proper caching and artifact uploads
acceptanceCriteria: Triggers on push to main and pull_request to main
Jobs: typecheck, lint, test, e2e (in dependency order)

subtasks.description: CREATE .github/workflows/deploy.yml: Automated Convex deployment on main branch push with production environment protection
acceptanceCriteria: Triggers on push to main and workflow_dispatch

subtasks.description: Verify CI workflow locally: Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test:coverage to ensure all would pass
acceptanceCriteria: All CI checks would succeed on PR

phases.gateCondition: Both workflow files created, local verification passes

phases.name: Sprint 04 - Browser-CLI Comprehensive Testing (P1)
phases.description: Validate all improvements through end-to-end browser testing. 16 tests across 6 suites covering all portals and improvements.

subtasks.description: Test Suite 1: Landing Page & Navigation - T1.1 Landing page load, T1.2 Navigation links
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page renders with hero and Provider Login

subtasks.description: Test Suite 2: Employer Portal - T2.1 Dashboard, T2.2 Employees, T2.3 Bookings (uses restoreState authenticated-employer)
acceptanceCriteria: Employees page renders list or empty state

subtasks.description: Test Suite 3: Admin Portal GDPR Performance - T3.1 GDPR Dashboard (<2s load), T3.2 Audit Logs, T3.3 Erasure Requests, T3.4 Employer Verification
acceptanceCriteria: GDPR dashboard loads in <2 seconds (validates Sprint 02)
Stats cards render: Pending Erasures, Active Patients
Audit logs page loads with entries or empty state

subtasks.description: Test Suite 4: Doctor Portal - T4.1 Dashboard, T4.2 Schedule, T4.3 Appointments (uses restoreState authenticated-doctor)
acceptanceCriteria: Doctor dashboard loads with today's appointments

subtasks.description: Test Suite 5: Error Handling & Edge Cases - T5.1 Invalid route (404), T5.2 Console error check, T5.3 Network health
Test Suite 6: Health Endpoint Verification - T6.1 Backend health check (validates Sprint 01 docs)
Evidence Collection: Organize screenshots into EVIDENCE_YYYYMMDD/, generate test summary SUMMARY.md

phases.gateCondition: All 16 browser tests executed, screenshots collected, SUMMARY.md generated with results

risks.description: GDPR stats caching requires schema migration - may cause brief service interruption
risks.mitigation: Convex handles schema changes automatically; test on dev deployment first

risks.description: Scheduled job may not trigger immediately after deployment
risks.mitigation: Manual trigger available via Convex dashboard; initial cache will be populated on first access

risks.description: CI/CD workflows require GitHub secrets configuration
risks.mitigation: Document required secrets (CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY) in deployment docs; workflow will fail gracefully if missing

risks.description: Browser state files (authenticated-admin, authenticated-employer, authenticated-doctor) may be stale
risks.mitigation: Re-authenticate and save new states if restoreState fails; credentials in .env.local
If test failures occur, downgrade with npm install glob@10 --save-dev

executionNotes.parallelCapability: Phases 1 and 2 are logically parallel-capable but will execute sequentially due to single-agent orchestration
executionNotes.criticalPath: Phase 1 -> Phase 3 (CI/CD depends on deployment docs)
executionNotes.independentPath: Phase 2 can execute any time before Phase 4
executionNotes.validationPhase: Phase 4 validates all previous phases through E2E testing
